1.explanation: HeaderMenu.js is the source of the problem: it hard-codes href="javascript:void(0)" on the menu toggle anchor, which triggers the React warning. The HeaderMenu-test snapshot records that exact href value; after changing it in HeaderMenu.js, the snapshot will no longer match and must be updated (or rewritten) to reflect the new, safe href (e.g. “#”), preventing test failures.
1.bug_scenario: In the UIShell HeaderMenu component, the menu’s toggle link is rendered with href="javascript:void(0)". React emits a warning (shown in the screenshot) that future versions will block javascript: URLs for security reasons. Replacing that href with a safe value (for example “#”) eliminates the warning.
